name: advent-of-the-stormcaller-decline-banish-rearranges-all-three-no-damage
notes: Advent of the Stormcaller (ZSSegCjquB): the player declines to banish any arcane card; no damage is dealt and the three revealed cards are rearranged back on top. Pre-fix declining skipped the follow-up entirely (and only the top card was revealed).

rulesClauses: Reveal the top LV cards of your deck. You may banish any amount of arcane element cards from among them. For each card banished this way, choose a unit and deal 2 damage to it. Put the rest of the revealed cards on the top or on the bottom of your deck in any order.
